# Historical Scene execution audit

**Provenance.** All citations below refer to expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/ablation_r1/generic_same_structured_evidence/C1/development/`. Their corresponding archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/ablation_r1--generic_same_structured_evidence.tar.gz`; each member is `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/ablation_r1/generic_same_structured_evidence/C1/development/` plus the cited relative file path. Line numbers are those of the original expanded files.

## French sitting room: commons_109923183

**Actual execution.** Step 2 completed a 16-sample render, saved `final.png` and `scene.blend`, and returned `ok: true`, with empty stderr [X0132, `commons_109923183/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7]. Step 3 instead timed out after approximately 108 seconds, with no image and no captured stdout or stderr [X0134, `commons_109923183/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]. This is a technical execution failure, not evidence that the proposed reconstruction was visually poor. The supplied task specifies a 512×384 reference, but provides no image for inspection [X0135, `commons_109923183/task.json`, lines 2–5].

**Step 3 code intent, not successful output.** The author’s review calls the prior seat shallow and chaise undersized, and proposes a camera change, 12% depth increase, −10° furniture rotation, wall shift and pillow turn [X0133, `commons_109923183/steps/003/build.py`, lines 7–26]. The code models a paneled room and individually boxed parquet boards; the chaise combines filleted seat and underframe, swept frames, legs, gilt details, ornaments and separately meshed upholstered panels. It also adds a pillow, card, cane chair and rod-like curtain folds [X0133, lines 52–105, 115–229, 303–333]. These placements describe intended geometry, not verified contact between parts.

The intended linen uses high-frequency noise bump and thresholded X/Y wave bands for colored dashes; walnut boards receive randomized materials with stretched noise bump [X0133, lines 250–301, 339–365]. The planned camera is at `(1.10, −4.25, 4.20)`, 48 mm with −6° roll; two area lights, Cycles, 48 samples, denoising and 512×384 PNG are specified [X0133, lines 16–23, 369–392]. None of these step-3 settings is a measured completed render.

## Ship compartment: commons_118588033

**Representation and revision.** The final supplied build uses boxes, rods, balls and filleted boxes grouped into a compartment shell, partition, column, three-tier berths, cabinets, heater, chair, plumbing and pendant lights [X0144, `commons_118588033/steps/003/build.py`, lines 27–97, 99–142, 159–178, 203–233]. Its comments identify excessive left cropping and an obscured chair as prior-image assessments; the code moves the cabinets and heater and rotates the forward chair −18° [X0144, lines 4–9, 99–122, 159–178]. These are author assessments and intended changes, not independent visual verification. Coordinates alone do not establish support or physical contact.

**Materials and render intent.** The build copies descendant deck materials before adding scale-38 noise and a subtle bump; it similarly copies diffuser materials and sets emission strength 5 [X0144, lines 264–295]. It specifies a 27 mm camera, 384×512 Cycles render, 64 samples and denoising, with three 65-power pendant emitters and front and rear fills [X0144, lines 10–16, 223–262]. The code’s positive-dimension and fillet comments are self-audit claims, not a collision test [X0144, lines 235–238].

**Execution and selection.** Steps 1 and 2 both report successful PNG and blend saves; their logs show **16 rendered samples**, despite their scripts requesting 48 and 64 respectively. The reason for the discrepancy is not established here [X0140, `commons_118588033/steps/001/build.py`, lines 189–195; X0141, `commons_118588033/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0142, `commons_118588033/steps/002/build.py`, lines 205–212; X0143, `commons_118588033/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7]. `selected.json` records step 3, while `record.json` has `selected: null`; the latter reports complete status, three executions and no runtime error, but the supplied sources contain no step-3 result log [X0138, `commons_118588033/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0137, `commons_118588033/record.json`, lines 16–18, 39–57].

The record marks structural, material and composite operability as passing, explicitly limiting interpretation to edit operability; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. It reports overall 0.435, SSIM 0.210 and LPIPS 0.745, not an independent acceptance of visual quality [X0137, lines 17–34]. Without the reference or rendered images, fidelity and any remaining visual defects cannot be judged.
